2609.00454.title: Location-Aware Language Models via Secondary Embeddings
2609.00454.paper_summary: Pretrained transformer-based language models achieve strong performance across a wide range of NLP tasks but remain limited in encoding geo-locational semantics, leading to suboptimal representations of place names and spatial entities. In this work, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic approach for injecting geo-spatial awareness into pretrained embeddings without modifying the tokenizer or requiring costly retraining. Our method augments input representations with structured geographic signals by combining location names with their corresponding latitude and longitude, and employs a location-focused masking to better align textual representations with real-world spatial relationships. This design allows the model to incorporate geo-spatial context while preserving existing semantic and syntactic knowledge. Experimental results demonstrate substantial improvements in geo-spatial alignment while maintaining comparable performance on standard NLP benchmarks such as GLUE. The method is computationally efficient, requiring only minutes of additional training, and generalizes across multiple model architectures and scales.
2609.00454.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練的基於Transformer的語言模型在各種自然語言處理任務中表現出色，但在編碼地理位置語義方面仍然有限，導致地名和空間實體的表示不佳。<lb/>在本研究中，我們提出了一種輕量級的模型無關方法，旨在將地理空間意識注入預訓練的嵌入中，而無需修改分詞器或進行昂貴的重新訓練。<lb/>我們的方法通過將地點名稱與其對應的緯度和經度結合，增強輸入表示，並採用以地點為中心的掩蔽，以更好地將文本表示與現實世界的空間關係對齊。<lb/>這一設計使模型能夠在保留現有語義和句法知識的同時，納入地理空間上下文。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，在保持與GLUE等標準自然語言處理基準相當的性能的同時，地理空間對齊有顯著改善。<lb/>該方法計算效率高，只需幾分鐘的額外訓練，並且能夠在多種模型架構和規模中進行泛化。
